notes.title: Mighty Arms Patch 1.1
notes.content:
🛠️ Mighty Arms Patch 1.1 is LIVE!


Patch 1.1 has landed, and the construction site is running smoother than ever.



🔥 What’s Fixed in Patch 1.1:

⚡ Generator task stabilized – The generators now receive damage appropriately and the enemies focus both equally. 
🏆 Achievements unlock properly – There were some rare occurances where individual achievements were not unlocked. This is now fixed. 
🤖 Enemy AI performance overhaul – Optimization in the enemies code has bettere performance 

💥 General performance - Performance polish applied.

notes.title: MIGHTY ARMS IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
💥 Mighty Arms is OUT NOW on Steam!
Starting today, August 1st, 2025, you can dive head-first into the most explosive construction brawler ever made.

Play as John Builder, the walking wrecking ball with fists of fury, and tear through armies of rogue construction bots gone mad. Elon Fusk's machines aren’t just malfunctioning — they’re out for blood. And you're all that stands in their way (or above them, mid-air, mid-punch).


🔥 Here’s what you can do RIGHT NOW:
🥊 Wreck with physics – Every swing, slam, and uppercut is gloriously unpredictable. Chaos is not a bug, it’s a feature.
🤖 Fight absurd robo-enemies – Hovering drones, drill-bots, and Fusk’s finest death machines.
🔧 Upgrade and go wild – Launch fists like rockets. Sprint like a caffeinated rhino. Be the destruction.
😵 Meet the weirdos – Elon Fusk, your boss, and you, possibly the strangest of all.
☕ Sip some coffee – Even demolition heroes need a quick break between chaos.


⚠️ This is not a drill.
You're not here to fix things, you're here to smash them to bits.
Grab your hard hat and jump into Mighty Arms right now. The construction site will never be the same again.



👉 Play it now on Steam
👷‍♂️ Tell your crew. Bring friends. Throw fists.
🧱 If you want to support the game further, be sure to leave a honest review!



Watch the release trailer: 
[previewyoutube="_2wiFDUJof4;full"][/previewyoutube]


Thank you for your support.

🛠️ Just another day on the world’s most dangerous construction site. Time to get back to work.

notes.title: Mighty Arms is about to strike!
notes.content:
🚧 The demolition is about to begin.


On August 1st, 2025, it’s happening: Mighty Arms launches on Steam and brings pure destruction with it. Physics meets fists, and you're right in the middle.

Play as John Builder, the human wrecking ball with two powerful arguments: his fists. The construction robots built by Elon Fusk have gone completely rogue, and only you can stop them — or at least smash them around a bit.



💥 Here’s what to expect at launch:

🥊 Physics-based brawling. Every punch is wild, heavy, and totally unpredictable.

🤖 Insane robo-enemies. From drones to demolition machines — they all want you flattened.

🔧 Upgrades and special moves. Boost your fists, launch them forward, sprint like a maniac, and unleash absolute chaos.

😵 Weird characters. Elon Fusk, your grumpy boss, and of course you — the weirdest of them all.

☕ Coffee. Because even demolition heroes need a breather.



🛠️ Just another day on the world’s most dangerous construction site. Time to get back to work.

👉 Add Mighty Arms to your wishlist now and be there when the fence comes down on August 1st.
